topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text:
The sun was just beginning to paint the sky with its warm hues when my neighbor, Jane, knocked gently on the back door. She held a small, hopeful smile and a trowel tucked under her arm. “I’ve been admiring your yard,” she began, her eyes twinkling with enthusiasm. “It’s so spacious and sunny. I was wondering, could I possibly use a small corner for a garden? I promise to take care of it, and you’re welcome to any produce it yields.”

The idea blossomed in my mind as quickly as the morning glory on the fence. I found myself nodding, already envisioning rows of vibrant flowers and lush vegetables, our community spirit growing right along with them. “Of course, Jane,” I replied, my heart full. “Let’s make something beautiful together.”
